endpoint_contract.arithmetic_density: Actual LamObj from KX5; independent disjoint torsion boxes, evaluated within finite algebraic extensions; all original point maps.
endpoint_contract.nonvanishing: Every nonzero original finite-free MK has every nonzero field fiber and admits an extension of each given coefficient point; every specified Hecke-algebra point occurs as an eigenvector. This does not prove MK nonzero for an arbitrary label.
endpoint_contract.coefficient_scope: Original arbitrary IsCO A, including nonreduced rings; point maps are allowed to be noninjective and nonflat. Tensor injections use the actual idempotent splitting.
endpoint_contract.fixed_embedding: The specified iota:Qbar_ell≃C is unchanged, and is never assumed continuous.
endpoint_contract.prime_scope: Weight density allows every prime. HSet applications retain ell!=2 and include ell=3. No substitution ell>=5.
endpoint_contract.local_normalization: Original uniformizer; U_a is the integral finite quotient sum. PS(omega)=normalized Ind(omega_i |.|^((n-1)/2)); psEig(omega,j)=product_{i<j} omega_i(pi) q^(-i). Global local generators use j+1 and lowVal(v,j+1)^(-1).
endpoint_contract.retained_literature: Only the source-supplied hLit and its exact bz/geo/disj clauses are used for the local principal-series step. No unconditional production of these hypotheses and no new class-A imports are asserted.
endpoint_contract.automorphic_scope: CFD12 and AFS19-AFS20 retain the source-supplied AutomorphicHeckeSet. The actual UnitaryPointProperties Galois attachment remains an installation frontier in AFS22.
endpoint_contract.choice_order: Fix original datum, rings, iota and lambda before torsion boxes; use the given x and one original sp; construct one action before all Hecke points and all parts; the scalar point of a nonzero part is chosen once before t and F; J remains the supplied kernel.
